publication_notes: Every Q3a row retains both 1-90 and 10-89 broad/crop score windows; ranking uses only the tight-fence 10-89 edge PSNR, then temporal p99 and mean.
H.264 dual-eye results are an offline NVENC proxy, not a live ALVR dual-stream implementation or headset qualification.
Full-FOV and cropped rows share the tight source fence but their whole-image HVS/VMAF domains differ; those whole-image values are contextual, not matched-domain gains.
NVENC observed elementary-stream rates are normalized over the external 90-frame sequence; PyroWave observed rate is 90-frame payload Mbps.
HEVC/AV1 Main10 rows encode from p010le and the observed decode is planar yuv420p10le; their documented full-range conversion then produces the 8-bit scoring input.

The frozen capture has 89 distinct payloads in 90 file-order frames and irregular original display timestamps; temporal metrics are sequence reconstruction error, not optical shimmer or fresh-90-Hz evidence.
No optical latency, decoder speed, fresh-submission rate, or stable-90-Hz claim is made by this quality-only Q3a publication.
